description: This dataset, hosted on Kaggle, contains photographs of piston components used in home air conditioners, intended for automated quality recognition during component manufacture. The provider defines three image groups. Defected 1 contains components described as broken, misshapen or fallen; Defected 2 contains oil, grease or rust stains; Normal contains components described as normal. This explicit building-service component and classification purpose supports a condition-monitoring use. Coverage is the manually collected component images. The inspected description does not state the number of images, image dimensions, file format, camera arrangement, collection dates, geographic location or independent label checks. The licence field says Other, specified in description, but the returned description contains no actual reuse terms. The licence and reuse cost therefore remain unknown. The resource does not establish operating HVAC measurements, component lifetime or building energy performance. No image, archive, code or trained-model file was requested.
